title: Compact-height Today, guides and settings
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity, realistically buildable UI review image for lilimio. (spell l i l i m i o followed by a small coral dot). This is a new visual overhaul of an existing public heat-awareness PWA. Preserve its warm forest/ivory identity: #F7F6EF canvas, #FFFDF7 surfaces, #244D39 primary, #18372C text, #59695F secondary, pale amber only for heat caution. Plus Jakarta Sans or its closest clean humanist geometric sans. Large readable body copy, deliberate hierarchy, thin consistent outlined icons, 48px-class buttons, 16–20px corners, fine dividers, almost no shadows. Use a restrained soft botanical landscape accent only where space permits; no generic gradients, glass, dense cards, oversized decorative hero, device photograph, or perspective. Polished flat front-on product screenshots, fully finished app viewports. Carefully typeset concise English text. No scrollbars, cropped controls, cut-off content, continuation below viewport, tiny text, or floating controls obscuring content. Prioritize content rather than scaling a desktop dashboard down. Every mobile frame must include safe-area breathing room and a fixed bottom navigation with labeled Today / Plan / More, except focused onboarding/full-screen dialogs which have Back or Close. Explicit back and close affordances. Preserve source uncertainty, no verified facility claims or safe-exposure guarantees. All displayed weather values are sample values. Outside the app frame(s), add a small editorial label "Concept · sample data". No marketing claims about accuracy, engagement, or validation.

Create a LANDSCAPE compact-height responsive design review board with THREE small short-screen app viewports side by side, each explicitly captioned outside the frame "320 × 568 · compact". The screens must be distinctly shorter and less dense than standard tall-phone mockups. No device hardware, no long descriptive paragraphs. Maintain a true 16px-class body and generous touch controls rather than shrinking the entire UI. Left TODAY: minimal 48px header with lilimio. and location Quezon City; title Today's heat; 64px-class hero38°C labeled Estimated heat index; small Air temperature31°C; concise amber Extreme caution row; one line "Model · 5 min ago" with refresh; one48px Plan outdoor time button; one48px Nearby station row with chevron; fixed Today/Plan/More nav with Today selected. Remove all illustration and optional chart to fit. Middle GUIDES: compact lilimio. header, Heat guides title, labeled search, exactly TWO guide rows Recognize heat illness and Stay hydrated, pager1 of3 and Previous/Next, fixed nav More selected. No artwork, no extra descriptions below pager. Right SETTINGS: compact header and title; Preferences / App & data segmented control; exactly FOUR rows Location, Units, Motion, Sources & accuracy; small version0.3.0 footer; fixed nav More selected. Use empty breathing room rather than adding more content. No scrollbars, no clipped text, no bottom continuation. Heading outside frames "Small height, fewer things—not smaller text" plus "Concept · sample data".
